entries.good_example:
error_exit() {
    local line=$1
    local code=$2
    echo "[SS QLM FATAL] Error on line ${line}: Exit code ${code}"
    # Logic for rollback
    exit "$code"
}
trap 'error_exit ${LINENO} $?' ERR
entries.rationale: Generic exits provide zero debugging info. A global ERR trap with line reporting allows developers to pinpoint failures in production immediately.
